That type theory does not originate in the problem of distinguish one kind of bit representation from another.

Type theory is concerned with the elimination of paradox from language. And it was shown long before there were modern digital computers that the theory of types could be generalized and applied to a wide range of situations simply by tagging words with version numbers.

So affine/linear safety is simply eliminating paradoxes!
